references.text: The burnt offering was to be a bull from the herd, a male without defect, in accordance with these requirements
The ram as a burnt offering is described in Leviticus as an acceptable sacrifice
A one-year-old lamb without defect was to be used for the burnt offering, the same requirement as in this verse
A one-year-old lamb for a burnt offering is also mentioned here as a sacrifice
One-year-old lambs as daily burnt offerings are prescribed here
One-year-old lambs without defect as daily burnt offerings are described
The same offerings were given by Nahshon, son of Amminadab, showing the standardized pattern for the tribal leaders' sacrifices
Nathanel, son of Zuar, gave the same burnt offering, confirming the repeated pattern
